_readme: Facts about the site that are the same in every language. Edit, push, and the website workflow redeploys. A null hides whatever depends on it.
_preview: true while the site is only a test: every page carries a 'Test version' banner, search engines are told to stay away, and until 'imprint' is filled in the imprint is a German page saying the site is a non-commercial test. Set false (and fill in 'imprint') when the site goes public.
_steam_app_id: The number in the Steam store URL. While null the page says 'Coming soon on Steam'; once set, every Steam button becomes 'Wishlist on Steam' and links to the store page.
_release: Shown in the fact sheet. null reads 'Coming soon' in each language; otherwise free text such as '2027' or 'Q1 2027'.
_contact_email: Press and business contact, shown in the press section and the footer. null hides it.
_imprint: Required for a German site (DDG §5). null builds no imprint page and the build warns. Fill it in like: {"name": "…", "address": ["Street 1", "12345 City", "Germany"], "email": "…"}
